Game Overview

In Hold the Balance, the core idea is straightforward: experience the thrill of balancing with precision in "Hold the Balance." Shoot balls strategically to keep shifting platforms steady. Navigate the increasing difficulty levels with quick thinking and skillful aiming. Aim for high scores on the global leaderboard, mastering each shot's angle and force for arcade dominance.
